title: Choose the visual world for KONSTANZ
question: The roll assigned Door Clipboard: tonight as a working guest list you mark up. Keep it, take an alternate, play the category straight, or re-roll.

options.label: Door Clipboard
options.lineage: Club door guest lists: ruled paper, highlighter, door price, stamp
options.thesis: Tonight is a working guest list you mark up, not a marketplace you browse.
options.viewport: Desktop: a paper sheet fills the fold under a clipboard masthead (KONSTANZ · SAT 30 AUG). Nights are rows — time, title, venue, door — first row larger; search finds on the list; highlighter marks I'm going.
options.risk: Reads as a spreadsheet if the paper and clipboard material are not fully committed.

raised.raise: Hairline isolation: filters and unsave sit in empty space; structure is rules, not card-shadow stacks.
Highlighting a night gathers it into My Weekend on the same sheet.
On the night sheet, the title is the largest object, not a caption under a photo.
Highlighter yellow is reserved by law for I'm going — never decoration.

options.label: Kulturblatt
options.lineage: Südkurier-style city culture listings: weekend going-out columns
options.thesis: Tonight is Saturday’s culture page: masthead, columns, nights as listings.
options.viewport: A newspaper masthead (KONSTANZ · WOCHENENDE) then three columns of nights; the lead night is a large listing, not a search hero.
options.risk: Also the direction most nightlife-web runs land on: editorial listings, cream paper, familiar city-magazine.

options.label: See Konstanz
options.lineage: WPA park poster: stacked silkscreen planes, one imperative in block caps
options.thesis: The lake is the product: nights live on stacked Bodensee planes under one caption, GO OUT.
options.viewport: Full-bleed lake planes; nights sit on the promenade plane; a caption bar states TONIGHT; no search hero.
options.case: Holds place-identity (Konstanz is the lake); loses Operate scanability for many doors.
options.risk: A poster you admire instead of a list you use to leave the house.

options.label: Door Clock
options.lineage: Seven-segment clocks, price totems, scoreboards: unlit cells designed too
options.thesis: The night is a time display: doors as digits, unlit cells for nights you are not going to.
options.viewport: A rigid mask of time cells; 22:00 Techno Friday as lit segments; other nights ghosted; price as a totem.
options.case: Holds identification (going out is a clock); loses clarity for venue, vibe, and photos.
options.risk: You know when, not where; a scoreboard that cannot show Blechnerei.

options.label: Night Console
options.lineage: Dark-first developer consoles: graphite, hairline seams, isolated destroy
options.thesis: Nights as panel output: graphite ground, syntax accents for state only.
options.viewport: Persistent panels; the list is a log of doors; selection changes panel contents, not the layout.
options.case: Loses both: students do not identify with a console; the task is choosing a door, not debugging one.
options.kept: Hairline isolation and state-only accent — written into Door Clipboard as Console isolation.
options.risk: Feels like a tool for promoters, not a night out.

options.label: Gathered Plan
options.lineage: Silk cape with gold drawcord: one pull turns a plane into a shell
options.thesis: The flat list gathers into My Weekend when you pull the cord.
options.viewport: A semicircle sheet of tonight; pulling the cord ribs Fri/Sat/Sun into a weekend silhouette.
options.case: Loses both: fashion transformation is not a going-out ritual; the gather hides the list.
options.kept: List-to-plan transformation — written in as highlighting that gathers My Weekend in place.
options.risk: A couture demo that cannot show the door price.

options.label: Letter Front
options.lineage: Alphabet storm: letters as weather that carve the landscape
options.thesis: Event titles condense as weather fronts across a white field.
options.viewport: One word-night (TECHNO) as a weather mass; details rain out as venue and time.
options.case: Loses both: surreal weather is not Konstanz nightlife; type-as-storm hides time and price.
options.kept: Type as matter at display scale — the night sheet’s title is the largest object.
options.risk: A poem about going out instead of a list that gets you out.

options.label: Night Cabinet
options.lineage: CRT arcade pixel glow: fat pixels, scanlines, reserved power-up gold
options.thesis: Doors as rooms on a tile grid; I'm going is the power-up flash.
options.viewport: A playfield of night tiles; score is door time; gold flash only for saved nights.
options.case: Loses both: arcade cabinets are not Bodensee nightlife; game UI fights door-price trust.
options.kept: Accent reserved by law for I'm going — highlighter is never decoration.
options.risk: A game about nights, not a guide to them.

canonCard.label: The discovery grid
canonCard.thesis: What event sites ship: search, category chips, a card grid, a featured hero.
canonCard.viewport: Top nav, large Discover headline, search + filters, featured cards, then a grid of nights.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from Eventbrite, RA, or Shotgun by design.
